title: An estuarine-inspired dual-gradient hydrogel for stable and scalable moisture energy harvesting up to a single-module 100 mA output
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04508H, Paper
Jie Miao, Haonan Wang, Nan He, Bingsen Wang, Mengting Zhang, Dawei Tang, Lin Li
A dual-layer hydrogel device with asymmetric water–salt gradients achieves 96.4 µA cm−2 current density and stable moisture energy harvesting for over 500 hours, alongside scalability to 1000 cm2, enabling a single-module output exceeding 100 mA.
